newsitem.title: USA: Marathon tests 3 East Texas Reef finds.
newsitem.headline: Marathon tests 3 East Texas Reef finds.

text.p: Marathon Oil Co said Monday it had made three more natural gas discoveries in the Cotton Valley Reef trend -- the Riley Trust No. 2 and the Sherrod No. 1 well in Robertson County, and the Noey No. 1 well in Leon County, Texas.

The company said the Riley Trust No. 2 encountered reef and tested at the rate of 27 million cubic feet per day at 7,610 pounds per square flowing tubing pressure. Marathon is the operator with a 75 percent interest. Broughton Associates Joint Venture owns the remaining 25 percent.

Marathon said the Sherrod No. 1 well tested eight million cubic feet daily at 2,225 pounds per square inch of flowing pressure and the Noey No. 1 tested two million cubic feet daily at 2,385 pounds per square inch of flowing pressure after perforating. Marathon holds a 100 percent interest in both wells which are scheduled for stimulation.
Marathon Oil is a part of the USX-Marathon Group (NYSE: MRO), a unit of USX Corp.
